description: This PHP source file defines the IoTSecureTunnelingClient class, which extends AwsClient, for interacting with the AWS IoT Secure Tunneling service. It includes method annotations for operations like opening, closing, describing, and listing tunnels, as well as managing tags and rotating access tokens.

classes.name: IoTSecureTunnelingClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS IoT Secure Tunneling service, providing methods for tunnel management and resource tagging.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a given resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: rotateTunnelAccessToken
methods.description: Rotates the access token for a tunnel.

methods.name: rotateTunnelAccessTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously rotates the tunnel's access token.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
